summary: GEGE Machinebouw is a Dutch machine builder in Uden that makes custom machines and processing lines for vegetable, fruit, horticulture and food processing. For potatoes it names a washing and sorting machine for thin-skinned early potatoes and says it builds custom lines for potato processors. Its website gives the founding year as both 1999 and 1991.
machines: Washing and sorting machine for early potatoes: washes, sorts and crates thin-skinned potatoes
Custom potato processing lines: machines and lines built to order for potato processors
facts: Member of the Koninklijke Metaalunie (Royal Metal Union)
Mushroom grading machine capacity stated as about 10 – 15 tonnes per hour (mushrooms, not potatoes)
limitations: Ownership, employee numbers, turnover and named potato customers or installations are not published on the pages read.
No capacity, model name or technology details are given for the potato washing and sorting machine.
The website gives two different founding years, 1999 and 1991.
